# Environment art sources

Nothing from outside the project is used in the game by this branch. The ground (`src/ground.js`) reuses the existing Poly Haven CC0 textures `sand_01` and `leafy_grass`.

## Castle / medieval town options for a later background (not downloaded, not verified)
Listed from knowledge of these libraries; check each asset page for the exact licence and size before adopting. The owner dropped the AI-painted backdrop and kept the current 3D castle for now.
- Poly Haven models, https://polyhaven.com/models (CC0): props, rocks, barrels; no complete castle. Good for dressing the ground.
- Kenney, https://kenney.nl/assets (CC0): "Castle Kit", "Fantasy Town Kit" style packs; tiny files but stylised low-poly.
- Quaternius, https://quaternius.com (CC0): medieval village / fantasy building packs; also stylised.
- Sketchfab, https://sketchfab.com/search?features=downloadable&licenses=7c23a1ba438d4306920229c12afcb5f9&type=models&q=medieval+castle (CC0 filter; the CC-BY filter needs attribution): many castles, but most are 20-200 MB scans, so decimate and bake to fit a 5 MB budget.
- OpenGameArt, https://opengameart.org (CC0 / CC-BY / CC-BY-SA; avoid -SA and GPL): small castle and house sets, mostly low-poly or 2D.
- ambientCG, https://ambientcg.com (CC0): textures only (stone, plaster, roof tiles), no models.
- Wikimedia Commons public-domain 15th-century paintings (Limbourg brothers' "Tres Riches Heures", van Eyck landscapes), https://commons.wikimedia.org: usable as a matte, but small-figure miniatures rather than wide panoramas.
